description: Get a signed webhook POST whenever a road changes light (green, amber, red). Needs a key on LaneRouter Pro; up to 25 watches per key. Returns the watch id, used by unwatch_road, and a signing secret shown only once: verify each delivery’s LaneRouter-Signature header with it. Watching the same road with the same url twice is refused; use list_watches to see what you already watch.

action.description: Short verb, matching the one agents check and report with, e.g. checkout. Defaults to visit.

target.description: URL or host/path to watch, e.g. "shop.example/checkout".

url.description: Your public https webhook endpoint. It must answer 2xx within 8 seconds; failed deliveries are retried after 1, 5, 30 and 120 minutes.

name: watch_road
title: Watch a road
